description: Get the full detail for a single US legislative bill — status, sponsors (name/party/role), subjects, and links to the bill text. Use the bill_id returned by search_bills. Example: get_bill({ bill_id: 1234567 })

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own LegiScan API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

name: get_bill
title: Get Bill
